en.topic_title: Shein shares dive more than 11% after earnings disappoint
en.topic_summary:
Shares in Chinese fast-fashion giant Shein plunged more than 11 percent in Hong Kong on Tuesday after releasing disappointing financial results.



Shein app. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.



The company has faced scrutiny over its environmental footprint and allegations of human rights violations, and faces growing competition from low-cost e-commerce companies such as Temu and AliExpress.
